title: Policy Signal Hub for Automated Retention & Proof Bundles
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Customers require a single control-plane signal that captures regional policy changes, tenant-level retention overrides, and evidence collection triggers so we can automate SOC 2/ISO artifacts. Today retention and residency rules are scattered across the console, runtime configs, and ops runbooks, making audits manual and error-prone.

Goal: Build a Policy Signal Hub (PSH) that ingests policy sources (region policy, tenant retention, legal holds), normalizes them into canonical signals, and emits events to the evidence-collector and retention-actor. PSH should support versioned policies, timebox overrides, and provide an exportable audit trail used by the evidence bundler to produce SOC 2/ISO reportable artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: PSH ingests policies from console UI, infra config repo, and API with at least 3 source adapters (console, infra git, REST)
Normalized signal schema documented and stable for 1 sprint (fields: policy_id, scope, region, retention_days, effective_from, effective_to, override_reason, owner)
Evidence-collector receives test signals and stores an immutable event with trace_id; retrieval endpoint returns event and associated policy snapshot
Retention-actor receives retention signals and schedules deletes/locks against a sandbox tenant with telemetry visible in Console
End-to-end demo with legal hold + tenant override producing a proof-bundle PDF with timelines and control mapping
All data flowing through PSH is logged to audit-log stream and accessible to the audit export tool for a given time window
updates: 2025-03-20 — Kickoff: scoped feature with Compliance, Legal, Console, and Infra. Agreed canonical fields and minimal adapters. Owner: Liam Chen.

2025-03-22 — Tech spike completed by ENG: prototype Kafka-based event bus with schema registry. Early perf looks fine for projected event volume. Spike PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/psh-prototype/pull/14
2025-03-23 — PM review: Adjusted acceptance criteria to require immutable snapshots exported with evidence bundles. Compliance asked for ISO mapping table to be included in the bundle.
2025-03-24 — Design review: Console UX will add "Policy Snapshot" view and a "Force Publish" button for emergency legal holds. Design specs: https://drive.redwood.com/design/psh-ui-v1

2025-03-25 — Blocker identified: Infra needs a short-lived KMS key per-tenant for evidence bundle encryption; security to advise on HSM integration. Raised dependency on security review (security_review_required=true).
notes: Trade-offs: initially we'll implement three adapters (console, git infra, REST webhook). Longer-term we can add runtime hook integration to emit residency changes during model rollout. Risk: key management for per-tenant encrypted bundles may slow delivery; mitigation is to ship unencrypted bundles to a secure S3 with restricted access and upgrade later. Follow-ups: analytics team to add retention signal dashboard, legal to approve evidence bundle schema, and security to confirm KMS pattern.
qa_plan: Create a sandbox tenant with a seeded dataset. Run scenarios: a) region policy change, b) tenant retention override, c) legal hold. Validate event lineage, bundle contents, and console visibility. Automated e2e tests in CI referencing test vectors from compliance team.
